summary: Assemble diffusion flux divergence as a tridiagonal operator plus boundary forcing

identity.direction: Explicit cell/face data to spatial operator or state update
identity.definition: Inner face flux=D_face*(u_right-u_left)/center_spacing; boundary Dirichlet flux uses half-cell secants, Neumann flux uses positive-coordinate gradient. Row residual=(right_flux-left_flux)/cell_width. Sum(cell_width*residual)=right_boundary_flux-left_boundary_flux. Signed D preserves algebra; physical diffusion requires D>=0.
identity.geometry: Explicit one-dimensional face grid, cell centers at arithmetic midpoints
identity.coordinates: Caller coordinate X; positive increasing direction
identity.boundary: One scalar Dirichlet value or positive-coordinate Neumann gradient at each end; homogeneous unit cross-section unless metrics supplied
assumptions: Finite converted-binary64 input quantities; caller supplies consistent units and normalization

inputs.name: d_face
inputs.description: Face diffusion coefficient, including any caller-supplied metric factors
inputs.constraints: Finite N+1 real array; physical diffusion nonnegative

inputs.name: var
inputs.description: CellVariable provides grid and scalar boundary constraints; assembly uses its shape and boundary data

outputs.name: matrix
outputs.description: TriDiagonal with diagonal/above/below, to_dense() and matvec()
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

outputs.name: forcing
outputs.description: Boundary contribution independent of cell values
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

preconditions: Declared shapes, domains and matching scientific conventions; no implicit broadcasting
supported: Assemble diffusion flux divergence as a tridiagonal operator plus boundary forcing
excluded: Uniform sine manufactured stationary solution exhibits second-order point error under grid refinement; arbitrary nonuniform convergence is not established.
No physical face areas or cell volumes inferred; all metric transformations and compatible coordinate units belong to caller.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for shape/domain/finite/masked input failures; FVM nonnumeric inputs raise TypeError. No partial result.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iteration; theta is one linear solve. No convergence flag is fabricated.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial output returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Derived from Apache-2.0 TORAX source commit4d338d0bd3f5fd38f1a9ebb36252dcb86c33412f. SciRel preserves the conservative two-point flux relation with explicit finite-value checks. Face-to-cell is reused from the maintained scientific library.
provenance.license_status: TORAX-derived implementation under Apache-2.0; full license and source attribution included in selected distribution.

example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fvm import CellVariable,make_diffusion_terms
v=CellVariable([.5,1.5],[0.,1.,2.],left_face_grad_constraint=1.,right_face_grad_constraint=1.)
m,b=make_diffusion_terms([1.,1.,1.],v)
np.testing.assert_allclose(m.matvec(v.value)+b,0.)

scope: Independent flux conservation, exact linear/constant states, uniform manufactured diffusion convergence and theta causality checks
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named discrete invariants and manufactured uniform-grid convergence; no arbitrary-grid stability/accuracy or full transport-simulation claim.
known_limitations: Uniform sine manufactured stationary solution exhibits second-order point error under grid refinement; arbitrary nonuniform convergence is not established.
No physical face areas or cell volumes inferred; all metric transformations and compatible coordinate units belong to caller.
